basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old tech enthusiast living in Ann Arbor, Michigan. By day, I work as a software developer specializing in front-end technologies. In my free time, I'm an aspiring PC builder and a huge fan of indie music, especially Jon Bellion. I also enjoy exploring the outdoors, particularly the natural beauty of the Florida Keys. I’m usually online during the evenings and weekends. I'm currently in a committed relationship and love spending time with my partner exploring new places and trying out the latest tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having graduated with a degree in Computer Science, I have a solid foundation in technology. My interest in PC building grew from watching YouTube tutorials and participating in online forums. Over time, I've become quite proficient in assembling and optimizing custom PCs, often helping friends and family with their builds.
